messages:
Elaine: Quick check — I'm about to open a small infra PR for the inference-gpu service. Goal: make rollouts less risky by doing a two-phase Helm rollout + move a legacy secret mount. Plan is:
- bump minReplicas: 1 -> 2 (chart values)
- initial rollingUpdate: { maxSurge: 0, maxUnavailable: 1 } (so new pods replace old ones) for the first pass
- then flip to { maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0 } after healthchecks for faster scale-up
- rename TF var `inference_secret_path` -> `inference_secret_mount` and update mounts from `/etc/old/keys` -> `/etc/keys` (will keep both paths in the pod during transition)

Before I open the PR: any objections or things I'm missing? tagging @Miguel for probe advice and @Karim for HPA/scale concerns. :slightly_smiling_face:
messages_2:
Miguel: Sounds reasonable. A couple of quick notes:
- Readiness probe needs to be strict during the first pass (otherwise the controller may consider new pod ready before model warms up). Consider increasing initialDelaySeconds and using an explicit /healthz/prefetch endpoint if we have one.
- preStop hook should delay termination until in-flight requests drain: e.g. `sleep 10` is okay but better if the app exposes a drain endpoint we can call.
- If the model warmup is expensive, the two-phase is good — but measure cost impact of minReplicas=2 during the transition window.

Example readiness tweak for first pass:
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz/prefetch
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 30
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 6
```
messages_3:
Karim: Couple more infra angles:
- Check HPA minReplicas: if HPA overrides minReplicas we need to ensure the controller doesn't reduce us back to 1. Make sure chart sets both Deployment.minReplicas (or HPA.minReplicas) consistently.
- Cost: if you want to avoid double-cost spike, we can do the two-phase during low-traffic window.
- For secret move, don't rotate volume mount in one go. Mount the secret twice for the transitional release using `subPath` or a symlink inside container. That way old code reading `/etc/old/keys` keeps working while new code reads `/etc/keys`.

Mount example (helm values snippet):
```yaml
volumeMounts:
- name: inference-secret
  mountPath: /etc/keys
  subPath: keys
- name: inference-secret
  mountPath: /etc/old/keys
  subPath: keys
```
messages_4:
Anya: FYI on Terraform side: renaming a var is a state-affecting change if you also rename the resource attribute in module calls. I recommend: open TF PR that adds the new var `inference_secret_mount` with default = old path, update modules to reference new var, run `terraform plan`, then after consumers are updated, remove the old var. Keeps drift minimal.

Commands:
```
git checkout -b tf/inference-secret-transition
# add new var to module
terraform plan -out=tfplan
terraform apply tfplan
```

messages_6:
Samir: Also add a temporary alert suppression for the pod restart spike and readiness failures — we got noisy pager hits last time. I can add a 1h suppression once you post the exact rollout window.
One more: add annotation `rollout.kubernetes.io/paused: "true"` to the ReplicaSet during the first roll if you want manual check before flipping surge settings. You can resume via `kubectl rollout resume deploy/inference-gpu`.
messages_7: Elaine: Great. I'll open two PRs: 1) TF var + module update (Anya suggestion), 2) Helm chart with two-phase rollout + dual-mount for secrets + readiness tweak. Will schedule rollout for 03/27 01:00 UTC and ping SRE for alert suppression. Thanks all — I'll drop link when PRs are up. :rocket:
